_source: Enemy.vb. Screen units, per frame. maxEnemy 13 is 14 enemies; mass is massBase + massRandom x rand. loadHP is loadEnemy's, resetHP Root.vb Reset's (every wave is a reset's). cautiousSeekMultiple is the Cautious state's 6 x seekSpd. enemySize is the quad an enemy is drawn on (setupVertex, from its X, centred on its Y; the port's position is the quad's centre). seekAimX and seekAimY are Seek's offsets from the angel: d = ((Angel.X - 0.1) - X, (Angel.Y - 0.05) - (Y - enemySize / 2)), so the point it closes on is the angel plus (seekAimX, seekAimY), seen from the quad's own X (left edge) and Y - enemySize / 2. spawnMin..spawnMax is the range loadEnemy and Reset draw each of X and Y from (getRndNum(-1, 1)), and a value inside spawnGapMin..spawnGapMax is redrawn, so an enemy starts in -1..-0.5 or 0.05..1 on both axes, mostly beyond the screen (-0.5..0.5 tall).

port._about: Not in the original. radius is world units, never mapped. seekCap is how many enemies may Seek at once: 14, every one, as Enemy.vb loadEnemy, Root.vb Reset and the Hurt recovery set Seek for all (BIBLE D18, settled by U.CHN-T81). A lower cap is UNI-T65's hang-back, kept only as a data option (spike U.CHN-T90): the rest wait in Cautious or Align. hangBackNear and hangBackFar (screen units, mapped by space.json) are the band waiting enemies hold: Align stalks in to the near edge, one angel width (angelSize 0.3) out, and Cautious backs off to the far edge, half as far again.
